debrief db-021
1) the a-c-t-o-r m-e-t w-i-t-h r-i-v-a-l-s to a-g-r-e-e on b-i-d p-r-i-c-e-s and l-e-f-t a m-e-t-t-i-n-g n-o-t-e w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the i-n-d-e-p-e-n-d-e-n-c-e c-o-m-f-i-r-m-a-t-i-o-n.
2) the a-c-t-o-r s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d d-u-m-m-y b-i-d-d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s to f-a-k-e c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-i-o-n and l-e-f-t f-i-l-e-d p-r-o-p-o-s-a-l-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-u-p-l-i-c-a-t-e d-e-t-e-c-t-i-o-n c-h-e-c-k.
3) the a-c-t-o-r c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d a r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n s-c-h-e-d-u-l-e for w-i-n-n-i-n-g b-i-d-s and l-e-f-t a r-o-t-a-t-i-o-n c-a-l-e-n-d-a-r w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t of i-n-t-e-r-e-s-t r-e-v-i-e-w.
4) the a-c-t-o-r a-c-c-e-p-t-e-d s-i-d-e p-a-y-m-e-n-t-s for l-o-s-i-n-g b-i-d-s and l-e-f-t b-a-n-k t-r-a-n-s-f-e-r r-e-c-o-r-d-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the d-e-c-l-a-r-a-t-i-o-n of b-e-n-e-f-i-t-s f-i-l-i-n-g.
5) the a-c-t-o-r s-h-a-r-e-d c-o-s-t e-s-t-i-m-a-t-e-s with c-o-m-p-e-t-i-t-o-r-s and l-e-f-t e-m-a-i-l t-h-r-e-a-d-s w-h-i-l-e s-k-i-p-p-i-n-g the f-i-r-e-w-a-l-l c-o-m-m-u-n-i-c-a-t-i-o-n a-u-d-i-t.

the t-r-a-n-s-a-c-t-i-o-n was d-e-t-e-c-t-e-d after the p-r-o-c-u-r-e-m-e-n-t was f-r-o-z-e-n for f-u-r-t-h-e-r i-n-v-e-s-t-i-g-a-t-i-o-n. all p-a-r-t-i-c-i-p-a-n-t-s were f-l-a-g-g-e-d in the c-o-m-p-l-i-a-n-c-e l-o-g. no s-t-a-t-e m-e-n-t w-a-s i-s-s-u-e-d in the f-i-n-a-l r-e-p-o-r-t due to o-n-g-o-i-n-g i-n-t-e-r-n-a-l r-e-v-i-e-w.
